title: notice-route shared definitions
description: Not an output on its own. Shared definitions referenced by the notification, CLI, hook and log schemas. config.json embeds its own copies.

level.description: Ordered info < warn < action < error. The order matters to destination floors and quiet hours; the notifiers do not use it.

destination_name.description: A destination name: 1 to 32 characters of [a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]*.

quiet_name.description: The name of a quiet_hours window (the destination name grammar).

rule_name.description: A rule name: 1 to 64 characters of [a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]*.

hook_name.description: The hook name of a hook payload: [a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,63} (else payload_invalid with pointer /hook); untrusted where it comes from a payload.

label.description: A key=value label, split at the first =. Key [a-z0-9][a-z0-9_.-]{0,63}; value 0 to 256 characters of [A-Za-z0-9._:/#@+=,-].

duration.description: Seconds as a positive finite number, or a string matching [0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?(ms|s|m)? (no unit means seconds); zero is refused. Booleans are never accepted. Ranges are enforced by the loader and named in the key's description.

duration_long.description: As duration, plus the h and d suffixes; used only by the keys that name hours and days (retention.* and dedup_window). Ranges are enforced by the loader.

sha256_16.description: First 16 hex characters of a SHA-256.

sha256_64.description: A full SHA-256 as 64 lowercase hex characters.

actor.description: human:<user> or auto:<name>. Advisory against same-user processes.

decision_id.description: A caller's --decision-id, recorded in the log only.

plain_string.description: A plain string: [A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._/#-]{0,255}. Plain values render in titles and messages and may be stored (event ids, object ids, label values).

event_id.description: A producer's event id: an integer (not a boolean) or a plain string; anything else is ignored. A redelivery matches on the id and the repeat digest; the id is compared as its JSON text, so 17 and "17" differ.

destination_outcome.description: The outcome of one destination in a send. sent never means delivered or displayed.

history_outcome.description: The outcomes of send except suppressed (a suppressed notification writes no row), plus sending (a row whose call is in progress, or whose process died during it; never in send output) and expired (an unclaimed queue row 24 hours old or more). history --outcome takes this enum, so --outcome suppressed is exit 2.

log_outcome.description: A destination outcome as logged: the eight of send (suppressed included) plus expired.

history_reason.description: The closed reasons of history rows. manual: a queue row ended by queue drop.

destination_reason.description: The closed reasons of send output and the log: the history reasons plus redelivered and repeat.

notifier_code.description: Untrusted. A notifier's error.code or refusal reason (read from its envelope and checked against this shape) or a router code: retries_exhausted, rate_capped, env_missing, overflow, expired, deployment_fault, exec_failed, generic_failed, envelope_invalid, output_overflow, killed, signal, other.

noop_reason.description: Why no destination was called at the top level of send and test: unconfigured, no_rule, all_disabled, disabled (exit 22) or rule_drop (exit 0). all_disabled is decided before any call: every selected destination is disabled, by enabled false in the router's config or by an override (destination disable).

error_code.description: refused is exit 20; usage, config_invalid and config_unsafe are exit 2; internal is exit 1.

refusal_reason.description: On exit 20 (code refused). claimed: queue drop of a row with a live claim.

key.description: config_invalid and config_unsafe: a key path, home, --config, . (the config directory itself), or the file path relative to the config directory (config_unsafe and unreadable files).

pointer.description: payload_invalid: empty for the whole input, /<field>, --source or --label. Never an input value.

error_details.description: Fixed strings and names only, never an input value; null when nothing applies.

message.description: A fixed string of the tool, never input text.

labels.description: All must be present among the notification's labels.

where.description: A map from payload field path to a string, integer or boolean; every pair must equal (same JSON type and value). Applies to hook payloads only; a condition that does not apply to a shape never matches it.

rule_match.description: All present conditions must hold. An empty match matches everything. source and labels apply to both shapes; hook, repo and where to hook payloads only; level_min to channel notices only (a notice without level counts as info) and may not be combined with hook, repo or where. In where, an integer is a number written without a fraction or exponent, so 1.0 never equals 1.

wildcard.description: An exact value of 1 to 256 characters, or a value ending in one * (prefix match; a lone * matches any present value). A * is allowed only as the last character (** or an inner * is config_invalid); matching is case-sensitive.

tool.description: The source of a hook payload (1 to 64 characters of [a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]*, else payload_invalid with pointer /tool). The source notice-route is reserved: send refuses it with source_mismatch.

event_id.description: Read for the redelivery check: an integer (not a boolean) or a plain string; anything else is ignored. A redelivery matches on the id and the repeat digest, per destination, source and hook; the id is compared as its JSON text.

object_id.description: Stored (and shown by history) only when it is an integer or a plain string, else null.

repo.description: Matched by a rule's repo condition; null counts as absent.

items.description: A key=value string; a malformed one is ignored and counted in labels_ignored.

labels.description: Array of key=value strings (split at the first =). A value that is not an array is ignored and counted once in labels_ignored. The first 64 elements are examined; each one that is not a string or not a valid label, and each element beyond 64, adds 1 to labels_ignored; a pair given twice counts once.

reads_third_party.description: Text opt-in needs the boolean false; any other value (missing, null, non-boolean) is unknown and excludes the text.

tainted.description: Text opt-in needs the boolean false; any other value is unknown and excludes the text.

hook_payload.description: A hook payload: required string tool and hook; any other keys are free, and the router reads only the scalar fields a rule or template names plus event_id, object_id, repo, labels, reads_third_party and tainted. Every field is untrusted unless the producer's interface says otherwise.

link.description: Lowercase http or https scheme, printable ASCII. Validated and never sent.

channel_notice.description: A channel notice: only title, message, level and link; message is required. A pass-through rule sends its title and message; its link is never sent.

claim_state.description: live: the one lease predicate says the row is claimed; lapsed: a claim is recorded but the predicate says it is not (expired, missing claimant or expiry, an expiry beyond now plus the lease length); none: never claimed or released.

queue_row.description: One queue row as queue list and queue show print it. Never the message, the link or the claimant token. Every column is checked against its grammar before it is printed; a row that fails is left out.

title.description: The stored rendered title cut to 100 characters, or null. Untrusted text: escaped by the printers.

reason.description: The stored reason of the row's delivery.

claim_expires.description: The recorded expiry of a live or lapsed claim, else null.
